headline: Chinese Humanoid Robotics Makers Expand Commercial Trials in South Korea
summary: Chinese humanoid robot manufacturers are stepping up factory trials and commercial deployment tests in South Korea, moving past showroom exhibitions as Seoul expands state investment in physical artificial intelligence.
why: Industrial automation and robotics are high-growth sectors addressing manufacturing labor shortages in East Asia. Commercial trials represent a key step toward large-scale industrial hardware sales.

entities.name: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy

impacts.name: Robotics
impacts.why: Factory trials expand adoption of physical AI systems in heavy industrial and manufacturing workflows.
